WITH radial_velocity_planets AS (
    SELECT p.planetref
    FROM planets p
    WHERE p.discmethod IN ('RadVel', 'RV', 'RV Method', 'Radial Velocity', 'Doppler')
),
well_char AS (
    SELECT dqt.targetlink
    FROM data_quality_tracking dqt
    JOIN orbital_characteristics oc ON oc.bodylink = dqt.targetlink
    JOIN physical_properties pp ON pp.objectlink = dqt.targetlink
    WHERE 
        -- Period relative uncertainty < 5%
        ((dqt.perioderr1 - dqt.perioderr2) / 2.0) / CAST(oc.period AS numeric) * 100 < 5
        AND 
        -- Mass relative uncertainty < 5%
        ((dqt.masserr1 - dqt.masserr2) / 2.0) / CAST(pp.massjup AS numeric) * 100 < 5
        AND
        -- Radius relative uncertainty < 5%
        ((dqt.raderr1 - dqt.raderr2) / 2.0) / CAST(pp.radjup AS numeric) * 100 < 5
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(
        CAST(COUNT(wc.targetlink) AS numeric) / CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM radial_velocity_planets) AS numeric) * 100, 
        2
    ) AS percentage
FROM well_char wc
JOIN radial_velocity_planets rvp ON rvp.planetref = wc.targetlink;
